lead.label: 4i
lead.why: Abstract: 'compound 4i displaying sub-micromolar IC50 values across multiple lymphoma cell lines'; 4i is the compound used for the mechanism studies (G2/M arrest, apoptosis, ROS).

reactions.conditions: Pfitzinger: aq. KOH 10%, acetone, microwave 150 C, 100 W, 2 x 15 min; then HCl 37% to pH < 6.5. 93%.
reactions.source: Section 4.1.2 (main text, p. 9); Scheme 1 step a

reactions.conditions: EDC.HCl, HOBt (0.2 eq), DMAP (2 eq), anhydrous MeCN, microwave 50 C, 60 W, 2 x 20 min; water, crystallisation from EtOH. 55%.
reactions.source: Section 4.1.3 general procedure and 4.1.3.9 (3i); Scheme 1 step b

reactions.conditions: Benzaldehyde (1.0 eq), glacial AcOH (1.5 mL/mmol), microwave 150 C, 200 W, 2 x 20 min; water, crystallisation from EtOH. 63%.
reactions.source: Section 4.1.4 general procedure and 4.1.4.9 (4i); Scheme 1 step c

notes: Benzaldehyde as the aldehyde for 4i is inferred from the product name (unsubstituted styryl); the general procedure says 'appropriately substituted benzaldehyde'. Acetone given as a commercial building block (carbon source in the Pfitzinger step).
